findings.requirement: The local VEC assembler must allocate integer ticks using duration weights, dialogue anchors, and a segment-length ceiling, then bind dialogue audio locally.
code_evidence: 01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/domain/facts.py exposes source spans and dialogue text but no timeline dialogue-anchor field or scene-span denominator.
01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/domain/time.py exposes no GenerationSegment maximum duration capability.
01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/services/timeline_allocator.py has a per-shot constant only; no architecture-defined segment ceiling.
01_调度器/mode_p_vnext/services/vec_assembler.py can only emit a nominal positive AudioEvent interval without an authorized temporal placement rule.
findings.root_cause: The v2.2 typed-fact amendment repaired semantic provenance but did not define the missing temporal contract that v2.0 requires VECAssembler to consume.
rejected_options: Map normalized-source character offsets to ticks: source spans are evidence locations, not a defined timing coordinate system or full scene denominator.
Invent a segment duration in code: the required ceiling has no authority-defined value or capability record.
Infer timing or entity semantics from statement/reference_intents/audio_intents: v2.2 section 2.5 expressly forbids natural-language inference for binding.
findings.required_architecture_repair: A versioned amendment must define a locally assembled typed dialogue-anchor mapping, collision/interval policy, and a capability-owned generation-segment ceiling before A1, A4, and A5 are revalidated.

work_performed_before_closure.failure_first_result: The v2.2 typed-fact test suite initially failed 19 tests because legacy VEC assembly decoded fact_id prefixes and statement text.
work_performed_before_closure.candidate_fix_result: A scoped candidate implementation made the A5 suite pass 33/33 by consuming FactSemantic, subject_id, and spoken_text only; it is intentionally not claimed as A5 completion because the temporal invariant remains unrepresentable.
